# Pillow advisories pip-audit is told to skip, one ID per line.
#
# WHY THEY ARE SKIPPED. Every one is a parser bug triggered by opening an
# attacker-supplied image (TIFF, GIF, BMP, FPX, PDF, ...). app.py opens no
# outside image: there is no file_uploader or camera_input, and its one
# PILImage.open (_pdf_image_from_figure) reads back a PNG matplotlib has just
# rendered into memory. No visitor can reach any of them.
#
# WHY NOT JUST UPGRADE. Every fix is in Pillow 13.0.0, and Streamlit up to
# 1.66.0 requires pillow<13. Pillow is pinned only by Streamlit, so the fix
# arrives with the Streamlit upgrade (1.66.1+ allows pillow<14), which is a
# deliberate change of its own: CLAUDE.md records several 1.58-specific CSS
# hooks that must be re-verified.
#
# DELETE THIS FILE WHEN STREAMLIT MOVES. A NEW Pillow advisory still fails the
# audit on purpose: check it is also unreachable before adding its ID here.
# Added 2026-11-14 (pip-audit against Pillow 12.3.0).
